report.summary: Reviewed chunk 4 of vendors.py: council_env, council_cwd, run_managed, CouncilProfile, FORBIDDEN_ARG_FRAGMENTS. Checked docstring claims against code.

handoff.purpose: Define council environment, working directory, runner, profile, and forbidden arg fragments.

symbols.name: council_env
symbols.note: Returns environment dict with OLLAMA_HOST stripped.

symbols.name: council_cwd
symbols.note: Creates a temporary directory, optionally validates it's not inside repo_root.

symbols.name: run_managed
symbols.note: Spawns a ManagedProcess with stdin from file, timeout, and cancellation.

symbols.name: CouncilProfile
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass for one-shot vendor CLI invocation.

claims.text: Environment for a council subprocess, with ``OLLAMA_HOST`` STRIPPED.
claims.why: The function pops 'OLLAMA_HOST' from the env dict.

claims.text: Never set, never mutated, never inherited
claims.why: The function returns a new dict; it does not modify the input or os.environ.

claims.text: A council that normalises a remote Ollama into a shared environment silently invalidates ``offload.py``'s trusted-lane justification repo-wide.
claims.why: offload.py is not in this chunk.

claims.text: A fresh, EMPTY temp directory to spawn a council subprocess in.
Not the repo, not a worktree, containing no repo files.
claims.why: Cannot verify that it is not the repo or worktree; it is a fresh temp dir.

claims.text: Returned as a context manager so the directory is fresh per call and removed after.
claims.why: Returns a TemporaryDirectory object which is a context manager.

claims.text: Raises if the system temp dir somehow sits under ``repo_root``, because a reviewer rooted in the checkout is the failure this exists to prevent.
claims.why: Code checks if repo_root is an ancestor of the temp dir and raises ValueError.

claims.text: THE PROMPT IS NEVER IN ``argv``.  It is staged to a temp file and handed over as the child's stdin.
claims.why: stdin_text is written to a file in a temp directory, and that file is used as stdin.

claims.text: A file rather than a pipe because a CLI that never drains stdin deadlocks the writer OUTSIDE every timeout
claims.why: The code uses a file; the reasoning about pipes is not testable from code alone.

claims.text: because on the ssh path a command-line prompt is re-parsed by the remote login shell, which turns any backtick or ``$(...)`` in a diff into remote code execution with no adversarial model required.
claims.why: No SSH path or remote execution is visible in this chunk.

claims.text: The whole process TREE dies on timeout.  ``Popen.terminate`` reaches the immediate child only; a hung vendor's grandchildren outlive it.
claims.why: Uses ManagedProcess.cancel(); implementation of cancel is not in this chunk.

claims.text: ``args`` never contains the prompt: :attr:`stdin_prompt` is always true here and the shape is enforced by test, not by convention.
claims.why: CouncilProfile has stdin_prompt=True by default; enforcement by test is not in code.

claims.text: Forbidden anywhere in a council argv.  ``workspace-write`` and ``dontAsk`` are the two flags that turn a reviewer into an agent with an editor.
claims.why: No usage of FORBIDDEN_ARG_FRAGMENTS in this chunk.

observations.what: council_env returns a new dict, does not mutate os.environ or base.
council_cwd creates a temporary directory and optionally validates it's not under repo_root.
run_managed uses ManagedProcess for cancellation and timeout; implementation of ManagedProcess not in chunk.
CouncilProfile is frozen and has default values for model_arg, default_model, lane, stdin_prompt.
FORBIDDEN_ARG_FRAGMENTS is defined but not used in this chunk.
